name: Alternative Me
playbook: Account required. Signup is display name, email, password, and no verification email ever arrives, so the account sits as 'Alternative.me Pending User' with an Unverified Email-Address badge that Resend does not clear. That badge does NOT block submitting. Submission is a modal from the account dashboard, never a public form. The autosaved draft keeps only the name and the icon, so press Save Draft before the modal can close or everything typed is gone. The important one: the Submit button does not respond to a synthetic click. It is not disabled, has pointer events, throws no validation error and logs nothing, it simply leaves the record in Saved Drafts. A human clicking the same button on the same draft submits it instantly, so fill the form, save the draft, and hand the last click to a person rather than burning attempts on it.

playbook: The /submit page is their own marketing list of 107 other directories, not a form. The real form is /services/submit. It asks for the site URL first, then either shows a fresh form or, if they already auto created a listing for the domain, offers to verify ownership instead.
